Title: Retirement: Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.4

Body.Content: End of Support Announcement for Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.4. Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.4 will be deprecated and disabled March 31, 2026.
Body.Markdown:
End of

Support Announcement for Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark

3.4. Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.4 will be deprecated and

disabled March 31, 2026.
